title: Income Annuities Service Cutoffs, Payment Methods and Tax Settings
content:
Payment methods, service cutoffs and tax settings for Ashgrove Income Annuities, identical on the Life Only, Cash Refund, 10-Year Certain, 20-Year Certain, Joint 50% Survivor and Joint 100% Survivor tiers:

| Setting | Value (all six tiers) | What it governs |
|---|---|---|
| Payment methods | Direct deposit; check | The ways payments may be made |
| Payment instruction cutoff | 10 business days | A payment instruction change received at least this many business days before a payment date applies to that payment |
| Bank change hold after an address change | 30 calendar days | Period after an address change during which a bank account change is accepted only on a signed, signature-verified request |
| Withholding election cutoff | 10 business days | A withholding election received at least this many business days before a payment date applies to that payment |
| Withholding on periodic payments with no election on file | Per the IRS withholding tables | The withholding applied to periodic payments when no election is on file |
| Exclusion ratio | Applies | Non-qualified payments are split into a tax-free return of investment and a taxable part |

**Cutoff illustrations (hypothetical, counting business days only).** A bank account change received 10 business days before a payment date meets the 10-business-day cutoff for that payment; one received 9 business days before does not. The same counting applies to a withholding election against its own 10-business-day cutoff.

**Hold illustration (hypothetical).** Where a contract's mailing address was changed twice, on 1 March and again on 1 June, the 30-calendar-day hold is measured from 1 June, the most recent address change.
